# SpatialMultiplexingOfVortices

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of combining multiple vortex beams in the same spatial region while preserving their individual topological identities through spatial separation or mode orthogonality. Increases information density and enables simultaneous multi-channel optical processing, critical for scalable TCC and iNEST systems.
